intro: Vile Satyr! Dryads in Danger! is an urgent Alliance quest begun in Ashenvale by the dryad Illiyana. Desperate for aid, she recruits travelers to search for her missing sisters who ventured into the corrupted ruins of Xavian to recover a stolen sacred relic.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Listen, I don't know who you are, but I need your help. My sisters went to take back the Branch of Cenarius from the satyr. They said they'd be back soon, but it's been two whole days!
Friend, you have to find them! They were looking for the ruins of a night elf temple in Xavian to the northeast. I don't know what to think. Look for Anilia, she was leading them on the search.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Judging by the gaping wound in her side, Anilia is on the verge of death.
